subject: Always keep an in-memory history of all commands in redis-cli (#12862)
reason: The change only affects valkey-cli's interactive line-editing history, and every changed code path is gated on isatty(fileno(stdin)) being true (redis-cli.c:3366-3375 sets history/historyfile only on a real terminal; FAKETTY only fakes stdout's tty at redis-cli.c:9907). The fuzzer's valkey.action.tools feeds tools stdin over a pipe with no pseudo-terminal, so in any run it can produce, history stays 0, historyfile stays NULL, and linenoiseHistoryAdd/Save/Load are never called on either build: the two builds are byte-identical in output, exit status, and files written, making every expect_diffe
